story.text: 번화가의 노래방 간판이 알록달록하게 빛났다. 하늘은 익숙하게 앞장서서 작은 방 하나를 골랐다.
story.reading: beon-hwa-ga-ui no-rae-bang gan-pan-i al-lok-dal-lok-ha-ge bit-nat-da. ha-neul-eun ik-suk-ha-ge ap-jang-seo-seo jak-eun bang ha-na-reul gol-lat-da.
story.en: The noraebang sign in the busy street glowed in bright colors. Haneul strode ahead like he'd done this a hundred times and picked out a small room.

story.text: 그는 리모컨을 집더니 능숙하게 번호를 눌렀다. "일단 내가 하나 예약해놨어." 첫 곡부터 신나는 곡이 흘러나왔다.
story.reading: geu-neun ri-mo-keon-eul jib-deo-ni neung-suk-ha-ge beon-ho-reul nul-leot-da. il-dan nae-ga ha-na ye-yak-hae-nwass-eo. cheot gok-bu-teo sin-na-neun gog-i heul-leo-na-wat-da.
story.en: He grabbed the remote and punched in numbers with practiced ease. "I already queued one up first." An upbeat track started playing right away.

story.text: "내 신청곡이야." 나는 마이크를 붙잡고 좋아하는 노래 번호를 눌렀다. 예상보다 잘 부르는 내 모습에 하늘이 눈썹을 슬쩍 올렸다.
story.reading: nae sin-cheong-gog-i-ya. na-neun ma-i-keu-reul but-jap-go jo-a-ha-neun no-rae beon-ho-reul nul-leot-da. ye-sang-bo-da jal bu-reu-neun nae mo-seub-e ha-neul-i nun-sseob-eul seul-jjeok ol-lyeot-da.
story.en: "This one's my request." I grabbed the mic and punched in the number for a song I liked. Haneul raised an eyebrow slightly, surprised I could actually sing.

story.text: 그러다 화면에 낯선 발라드가 떴다. "이건 내 애창곡이야." 그가 담담하게 마이크를 넘겨받았다. 반전이었다. 무뚝뚝한 그가 부르는 노래는 의외로 다정했다.
story.reading: geu-reo-da hwa-myeon-e nat-seon bal-la-deu-ga tteot-da. i-geon nae ae-chang-gog-i-ya. geu-ga dam-dam-ha-ge ma-i-keu-reul neom-gyeo-bad-at-da. ban-jeon-i-eot-da. mu-ttuk-ttuk-han geu-ga bu-reu-neun no-rae-neun ui-oe-ro da-jeong-haet-da.
story.en: Then an unfamiliar ballad popped up on screen. "This is my go-to song," he said flatly, taking the mic. It was a twist — the song this blunt guy sang turned out surprisingly gentle.

story.text: 점수가 뜨자마자 그는 승부욕을 드러냈다. "몇 점 나왔어? 나보다 낮으면 안 되는데." 순위를 두고 우리는 유치하게 다퉜다.
story.reading: jeom-su-ga tteu-ja-ma-ja geu-neun seung-bu-yog-eul deu-reo-naet-da. myeot jeom na-wass-eo? na-bo-da naj-eu-myeon an doe-neun-de. sun-wi-reul du-go u-ri-neun yu-chi-ha-ge da-twot-da.
story.en: The moment the score popped up, his competitive streak came out. "What'd you get? You'd better not score lower than me." We bickered childishly over the ranking.

story.text: 신이 난 나는 탬버린을 마구 흔들며 소리를 질렀다. 하늘도 어느새 박자에 맞춰 어깨를 들썩이고 있었다.
story.reading: sin-i nan na-neun taem-beo-rin-eul ma-gu heun-deul-myeo so-ri-reul jil-leot-da. ha-neul-do eo-neu-sae bak-ja-e mat-chwo eo-kkae-reul deul-sseog-i-go iss-eot-da.
story.en: Getting excited, I shook the tambourine wildly and shouted along. Before I knew it, even Haneul was bobbing his shoulders to the beat.

story.text: 문 밖으로 나오니 밤공기가 시원했다. "다음엔 내가 방 예약할게." 나는 웃으며 말했고, 하늘도 드물게 활짝 웃었다.
story.reading: mun bakk-eu-ro na-o-ni bam-gong-gi-ga si-won-haet-da. da-eum-en nae-ga bang ye-yak-hal-kke. na-neun us-eu-myeo mal-haet-go, ha-neul-do deu-mul-ge hwal-jjak us-eot-da.
story.en: Stepping outside, the night air felt cool and refreshing. "Next time, I'll book the room," I said with a laugh, and even Haneul, rare for him, grinned wide.

words.example_en: Can I sing my requested song?
I got a good score this time.
My go-to song is a ballad.
I sang while shaking the tambourine.
